name: iMessage — the bug (horizontal)
description: A live iOS Messages conversation on a transparent overlay. The thread plays out over ~6s: a gray received bubble pops in, a three-dot typing indicator appears and resolves into the next bubble, a heart tapback pops onto it, then a blue sent reply arrives with a Delivered → Read receipt, and it holds. Faithful iOS Messages look BY DESIGN: white page, gray (left) / blue (right) bubbles with tail curls, an iOS header (back chevron, contact avatar + name, FaceTime icon) — NOT a web page (no browser chrome), and NO CSS glow on the captured card. Transparent WebM overlay, composited over footage.

messages.text: the bottleneck was a console.log inside a hot loop
